body:
1. The `CodeTextEditor::error` label should have auto translation disabled. Its content is dynamically built / translated elsewhere.
https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/e45cc68092906465df3ea9e820a7c77d602addb1/editor/code_editor.cpp#L1902

1. Missed the `TTR()` place holder :P
https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/e45cc68092906465df3ea9e820a7c77d602addb1/editor/plugins/script_editor_plugin.cpp#L4182-L4184

1.  The `ConnectionInfoDialog::method` label should have auto translation disabled. Its content is the method name.
https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/e45cc68092906465df3ea9e820a7c77d602addb1/editor/plugins/script_text_editor.cpp#L102

1. You might also want to go through `editor/plugins/text_editor.cpp`. Some of the script editor's menu items are still using `TTR()` when editing text files.

p.s. Typo in the commit title, BTW

The `toggle_files_button` in EditorHelp / ScriptTextEditor / ScriptTextEditor can have tooltip auto-translation disabled.

Otherwise looks good.
